rows.historical_depth_required: >=8y daily surface preferred; 2007+ acceptable for ETF proxy
rows.timestamp_requirement: session or exchange timestamp; knowledge <= next bar open
rows.lookahead_risk: using settled IV after the bar close; using revised IV marks

rows.lookahead_risk: adjusted continuous series hides roll; Yahoo continuous is not PRODUCTION
